# HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony 移植

[English](OHOS.md)

这个分支包含 FileKit 的实验性 OHOS 移植。由于该移植依赖 CPF Kotlin/Native 工具链，
并且可能独立于上游 FileKit 演进，因此相关说明单独放在这里。

## 支持矩阵

| 模块 | `ohosArm64` | `ohosX64` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filekit-core` | 支持 | 支持 |
| `filekit-dialogs` | 支持 | 支持 |
| `filekit-dialogs-compose` | 支持 | 支持 |
| `filekit-coil` | 支持 | 暂未发布 |

当前移植基于 CPF Kotlin `2.2.21-1.0.0`。Core 使用 OHOS 应用上下文提供的沙箱目录。
Dialogs 通过 Kotlin/Native N-API 调用系统选择器，并返回基于复制后文件描述符的
`PlatformFile`。

## 应用接入

宿主 UIAbility 必须在第一次调用选择器之前初始化 FileKit，并且初始化必须发生在
ArkTS/UI 线程。应用通过已有的 N-API 入口把当前 `napi_env` 和页面所属的
`UIAbilityContext` 传给 Kotlin：

```kotlin
import io.github.vinceglb.filekit.FileKit
import io.github.vinceglb.filekit.dialogs.dispose
import io.github.vinceglb.filekit.dialogs.init

FileKit.init(env, context)

// 在同一个 UIAbility 的销毁回调中调用：
FileKit.dispose()
```

这里的 `context` 必须是页面的 `UIAbilityContext`，不能使用 ApplicationContext。
这种模式不需要复制 FileKit 的 `.ets` 文件，也不需要注册 FileKit 专用 dispatcher。

选择器返回的 `PlatformFile` 使用完后必须调用 `close()`。如果需要跨应用启动保存，
请先把文件复制到 `FileKit.filesDir`。

## 本地发布

```sh
./gradlew publishToMavenLocal -PRELEASE_SIGNING_ENABLED=false
```

消费端需要在远程仓库之前加入 `mavenLocal()`。版本号来自 `gradle.properties` 中的
`VERSION_NAME`。

## 验证状态

详细的宿主示例和手动测试说明见
[`samples/ohos-integration/README.md`](samples/ohos-integration/README.md)。当前已完成两种
OHOS 架构的编译，并在 ARM64 HarmonyOS 模拟器上验证了系统模块加载、保存/读取、文档选择、
照片选择取消、错误传播、请求串行化和资源释放。

相机拍摄、目录选择、分享、真实设备权限差异仍需要在对应设备上验证。

# OC Desktop · Electron on HarmonyOS Edition（`oc-desktop-hos`）

> **版别定位：Electron on HarmonyOS Edition** —— OC Desktop 的两个鸿蒙版别之一；
> 另一个是 [`oc-desktop-ark`](../oc-desktop-ark)（**HarmonyOS Edition**：进程内 Node + ArkWeb，无 Electron）。
>
> 本版用 `harmonypc-electron` 提供的 Electron-on-HarmonyOS 运行时承载 **opencode v2 的服务端**，
> 渲染层以 **ArkWeb（目标）/ Chromium（回退）** 同源加载服务端内嵌的 v2 Web UI，打包为可签名分发的 HAP。

> **本工程非 opencode 团队构建**，与 [opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) 无隶属关系；
> opencode 为上游开源项目，本工程仅是其桌面形态在 HarmonyOS 上的第三方移植。

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 应用名 / bundleName | **OC Desktop** / `org.fellow99.oc.OCDesktop` |
| 版本 | **`2.0.26`** / `versionCode` **20026**（规则 `major*10000 + minor*100 + patch`；版本规格见 `specs/101-version-2.0.26/`） |
| 目标设备 | `2in1` / `tablet`（不做 phone） |
| 上游基线 | opencode **v2.0.26**（tag `v2.0.26` / 提交 `9b4ec5714d` / 分支 `Branch_v2.0.26`） |
| 运行时 | Electron **37**（`v37.2.3-20260825.1` = Node **22.17.0** / Chromium 138 / ABI **v138**）；Electron 40（Node 24.11.1）为触发式备选 |
| 工程规划 | [`docs/工程规划-V2.md`](docs/工程规划-V2.md)（**唯一设计依据**；V1 为历史基线） |
| 骨架镜像源 | `dsh-desktop-hos`（只镜框架，不搬业务） |

## 构建流水线（host 侧 Windows；任一失败即中止，绝不静默降级）

```powershell
# 0) 前置：DevEco Studio（含 hvigor/ohpm/node/sdk）、bun、git；工程与 ../opencode、../harmonypc-electron-versions 同盘符
$env:DEVECO_SDK_HOME = "D:\oh-workspace\DevEco Studio\sdk"

# ① 收集运行时（发行版归档 → electron/ + web_engine/ + SO + Chromium 资源 + libc++_shared.so；应用 overlay；跑守卫）
node scripts\collect-runtime.mjs

# ② 构建 opencode Node 产物（幂等打补丁 → bun install → build-node --target=linux-arm64 --bundle-only
# ② 收集壳应用层（把 plugins/oc-plugin-* 投放进 resfile + sha256 校验 + node --check + 静态断言）
node scripts\collect-app.mjs

# ③ 构建 opencode Node 产物（幂等打补丁 → bun install → build-node --target=linux-arm64 --bundle-only
#    → collect-opencode（品牌化 Web UI + 物化 better-sqlite3 + tar.gz + 校验 + 投放）→ smoke-node22 host 门禁）
node scripts\build-opencode.mjs

# ④ 构建 + 签名（必须用 DevEco 自带 JBR；脚本要求 pwsh 7+）
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build-debug.ps1

# ⑤ 安装 + 启动（部署前建议先卸载，清掉 userData 里的旧产物与 marker）
hdc uninstall org.fellow99.oc.OCDesktop
hdc app install -r electron\build\default\outputs\default\electron-default-signed.hap
hdc shell aa start -a EntryAbility -b org.fellow99.oc.OCDesktop
hdc uninstall org.fellow99.oc.OCDesktop
hdc app install -r electron\build\default\outputs\default\electron-default-signed.hap
hdc shell aa start -a EntryAbility -b org.fellow99.oc.OCDesktop
```

常用参数：

| 脚本 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `scripts/collect-runtime.mjs` | `--extract-only`（不覆盖 overlay、不跑守卫，用于首次导入/取材）、`--verify-only`（只跑守卫）、`--runtime-source <dir>`（用预解压的 ohos_hap） |
| `scripts/build-opencode.mjs` | `--skip-install`、`--no-smoke`、`--bun <path>` |
| `scripts/smoke-node22.mjs` | host 门禁（Node 22.17.0）：`--version/--help` → `serve` → `/api/info` → 内嵌 UI → SSE |
| `scripts/collect-opencode.mjs` | `--product <dir>`、`--no-app-copy` |
| `scripts/collect-app.mjs` | `--check-only`（只跑静态断言与 `node --check`，不投放）、`--self-test`（反向用例证明断言能失败） |
| `scripts/test-harmony-plugins.mjs` | 插件 host 侧语义测试（`grep`/`glob` 匹配、上限、跳过表、哨兵协议），全绿才允许打包 |
| `scripts/lib/branding.mjs` | `--generate-icons`（从父工程物料生成包内图标，幂等）、`--brand <in> --out <out>`、`--verify <bin>`、`--self-test` |
| `scripts/verify-branding.mjs` | 对任意 `app-archive.bin` 跑品牌化后置断言（30 项），非零退出即失败 |

## 关键约定（细节见工程规划）

- **服务端形态**：stock CLI bundle，宿主内 `process.argv = ["node","opencode.mjs","serve","--hostname","0.0.0.0","--port","<随机>"]`
  启动，密码走 `OPENCODE_PASSWORD`（v2 强制要求密码）；健康检查 `GET /api/info`。
- **宿主形态**：三候选（`OCR_HOST_MODE=inprocess|utility|worker`，默认 `inprocess`）——由 **Phase 0 P0-1 探针**定标
  （应用域 fork 出的 node 脚本存在 seccomp SIGSYS 风险，见规划 §3.2 的 ⚠️ 冲突登记）。
- **渲染通道**：`OCR_RENDER_MODE=chromium|arkweb`（默认 chromium 作为可用性回退；arkweb 为目标形态，上架合规要求）。
- **鉴权**：主进程走 v2 原生「配对码 → 会话 Cookie」通道（`POST /api/pair` → `/auth/connect/{code}`），
  把令牌写入渲染层 Cookie；配对不可用时回落到 Basic 头注入。凭据写入 `<userData>/ocr-connection.json`（0600）。
- **产物**：`opencode-dist.tar.gz`（ustar，顶层 `dist-node/`）+ **SHA-256 marker 强比对**，首次启动流式解压到
  `<userData>/opencode-dist/`；`better_sqlite3.node`（aarch64-ohos/ABI v138）随该产物分发（resfile 只读目录不能 dlopen）。
- **权限声明面（与 `dsh-desktop-hos` 完全对标）**：`web_engine` 23 项 `requestPermissions` + 2 项 `definePermissions`
  （含 JIT `kernel.ALLOW_WRITABLE_CODE_MEMORY`，须同时出现在 `requestPermissions` 与 `definePermissions`）、
  entry 模块 `KEEP_BACKGROUND_RUNNING` + `backgroundModes: ["taskKeeping"]`；其中 8 项带 `reason` + `usedScene`，
  弹窗文案取自 `web_engine/src/main/resources/<locale>/element/string.json`（已加入 `runtime-overlays/` 白名单）。
- **需 ACL 的只有 3 项**（`system_basic`）：JIT + `READ_PASTEBOARD` + `READ_WRITE_DESKTOP_DIRECTORY`，其余 21 项为开放权限；
  不申请 `CUSTOM_SANDBOX` / `RUN_ANY_CODE` / `kernel.LOAD_INDEPENDENT_LIBRARY` / `ALLOW_EXTERNAL_NATIVE_CODE`，
  并剪掉外壳默认的相机 / 麦克风 / 定位 / 蓝牙等 10 项（守卫 `PRUNED_PERMISSIONS` 断言这些名字不存在）。
  详见 `docs/ACL申请清单.md`（v3）。
- **上架合规**：EntryAbility 已去掉 `entity.system.browsable` / 深链入口（G1）；图标纯色不透明（当前为**占位图标**，发布前必须替换）；
  其余清单见 `docs/ACL申请清单.md` 与规划 §8.5。
- **签名**：本包名必须重新生成证书（不能复用 `com.huawei.ohos_electron`），并按本包名单独申请 ACL；
  `signing.{debug,release}.local.json`（gitignored，样例见 `*.sample`）。

## 当前状态

- ✅ 工程骨架、运行时收集（含结构化守卫全绿）、补丁集（`0001`–`0004`，往返校验通过）、构建流水线与
  host 侧 Node 22.17 冒烟门禁、规格与文档体系、上架合规守卫。
- ✅ **版本 2.0.26**（`versionName 2.0.26` / `versionCode 20026`）；在真机（HOS）完成构建 → 部署 → 启动就绪 →
  基本功能（DeepSeek API Key / 工作区 / 一次真实对话）验证。证据见 `docs/真机验证记录.md`。
- ✅ **鸿蒙环境能力清单（v2.0.26）**：`docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-v2.0.26.md`（真机实测；v0.1 版作为历史基线保留）。
- ✅ **品牌化**：界面与元数据的 `OpenCode` 收敛为 `OC Desktop`，Logo/图标统一取父工程 `assets/` 物料
  （详见 `specs/103-branding/`）。
- ✅ **鸿蒙 JS 工具（插件）**：把设备上不可得的能力用纯 JS 插件替代（详见 `specs/102-harmony-js-tools/`）。
- ✅ **Git 操作（插件）**：把纯 JS 的 `isomorphic-git` 嵌入服务端进程，提供 21 个 `git_*` 工具、覆盖 VCS provider
  （让自带 diff/分支界面可用）与「设置 → Git」凭据页（`~/.git-credentials`，`0600`）。详见 `specs/204-plugin-git/`
  与 `docs/204-插件-GIT.md`。
- ⬜ 能力缺口（v1 明确降级）：终端 PTY（平台级不可用）、`fff` FFI 内容搜索、LSP/formatter/MCP 外部进程、
  插件在线安装（默认关闭）、git/VCS（已被 204 的插件方案覆盖，见上一条）。详见规划 §7 与 `docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-v2.0.26.md`。

## 环境要求

- DevEco Studio（含 `tools/{hvigor,ohpm,node}` 与 `sdk`）、`bun`、`git`、`node`（脚本用）、**pwsh 7+**（构建脚本；Windows PowerShell 5.1 无法解析无 BOM 的 UTF-8 中文脚本）。
- 运行时归档与原生模块材料放在同级目录 `../harmonypc-electron-versions/`。

# liberika

> 「GOOD！我是liberika，是NipaPlay里继mdk、video player、libmpv、media kit之后的第五个播放器内核。」
> 「即便算上你，也只有四个播放器内核！」

**NipaPlay 的自研播放内核。** Rust 实现，可嵌入，从解码到渲染一手包办。

> 名字取自《海猫鸣泣之时》的侦探 **古戸ヱリカ**。
> 而 [NipaPlay](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload) 来自《寒蝉鸣泣之时》古手梨花的口癖「にぱー☆」——社区里大家都叫她「梨花」。
> 一个是台前的播放器，一个是幕后的引擎。同出一脉，互为表里。

宿主应用只需提供一个渲染表面并发送播放命令——解码、时序同步、音视频渲染、字幕、弹幕、音频输出均由 liberika 内部完成。原生视频层直接呈现；Flutter 纹理可交给宿主合成。

当前版本：**0.2.1**。从 [文档目录](docs/README.md) 选择接入、构建或内核设计说明。

## 能力

- 硬件解码与软件回退：VideoToolbox、D3D11VA、MediaCodec、AVCodec；Linux 提供 NVDEC / VA-API。
- Metal、Direct3D 11 与 wgpu 呈现，合成视频、字幕和弹幕；支持 HDR/EDR、Dolby Vision 映射与 ArtCNN 亮度超分。
- 本地文件与 HTTP(S) 播放，支持自定义请求头、后台预读和回退缓存。
- 音频主时钟同步、暂停、seek、倍速、多音轨、外挂字幕和多轨弹幕。
- Rust、C ABI、Flutter、SwiftPM 与 OpenHarmony ArkTS 接入。

## 选择接入方式

| Flutter | `flutter pub add erika_flutter`，当前 0.2.1 | [插件使用指南](packages/erika_flutter/README.zh.md) |

| OpenHarmony / ArkTS | `ohpm install erika` | [ArkTS SDK](packages/erika_ohos/README.md) |

await player.open('/path/to/video.mp4');

// 放入 Widget 树；Apple 全播放器可选 ErikaWindowOverlayVideoView。

Memex · Intranet Office Instant Messaging System

An office instant messaging system for physically isolated intranet environments, modeled on the functional scope of WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) and covering communication, office collaboration, organization, and archive search. The business layer is written entirely in-house, while the foundation uses open-source components: Qt 6, asio, protobuf, SQLite, OpenSSL, and the AWS SDK (S3 interface, paired with RustFS); the inventory and licenses are listed in [third_party/](third_party/README.md). The system is not built on top of any open-source IM project, and it integrates no components under strong-copyleft licenses such as AGPL or SSPL. Desktop clients are C++17 + Qt (Linux CI-verified; Windows/macOS artifacts come from the nightly build matrix); mobile clients are Android (Kotlin, shipped), iOS (Swift, code-only with CI verification), and HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS, code-only with CI logic verification); the server is C++17, a single process on a single database. ## Documentation - Documentation site (GitHub Pages): — UI previews, quick tour, architecture and compliance; source under `docs/` (VitePress, build with `pnpm docs:build`) - Product positioning: · source [docs/src/guide/product.md](docs/src/guide/product.md) - Review panel decision list (fifteen items + one optional): · source [docs/src/guide/decisions.md](docs/src/guide/decisions.md) - UI previews (live screenshots; 8 desktop screens + 4 mobile screens): · prototype sources docs/design/prototypes/ - Product definition and phase basis: [product plan review report](docs/建设方案评审报告-V10.0.md) - Requirements and task list (R1–R19 mainline, R23–R27 additional batches, four-phase breakdown, acceptance criteria): [todo.md](todo.md) ## Product Form A single installation package contains two communication engines: | Mode | How to enter | Link | Archiving | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Direct mode (default) | Works right after installation, zero configuration | UDP broadcast discovers terminals on the same subnet; TCP peer-to-peer connections (UDP uses 2425 only, 2426–2436 reserved / TCP 2426–2437) | Stored on the local machine only | | Collaboration mode (after sign-in) | Enter the server address and sign in | Persistent connection to the collaboration server | Fully persisted on the server, searchable | The direct engine keeps running after sign-in (cross-mode interoperability requires it); when the server is unreachable, the client falls back to direct mode automatically. **The only purpose of connecting to the server is record retention**: no secret chats, no burn-after-reading, no deletion of archives upon message recall, no unilateral deletion of archives from the client, and no user-facing switch to turn record retention off. Mobile clients run in collaboration mode only: the first launch must complete server address initialization, and anonymous use without sign-in is not provided. ## Monorepo Structure ``` memex/ ├── client/ # Qt C++17 desktop client (Windows / Linux / macOS) │ ├── app/ # Entry point and main window, system integration (tray, │ │ # notifications, autostart), screenshot annotation, │ │ # themes, notification preferences (UI layer merged into app) │ ├── engine/direct/ # Direct engine: UDP discovery, peer-to-peer messages and files │ ├── engine/collab/ # Collaboration engine: persistent connections, message sync, │ │ # offline messages and catch-up delivery │ ├── engine/task/ # External task providers (dingtalk / feishu / github) over a │ │ # capability SPI (L1 jump / L2 read / L3 write; Set up vcpkg (once; adding VCPKG_ROOT to your shell profile is recommended) [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-in%20development-orange)](https://github.com/cuihairu/memex/releases) git clone https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg.git ~/vcpkg ~/vcpkg/bootstrap-vcpkg.sh export VCPKG_ROOT="$HOME/vcpkg" # 2. Development build (Release · server + client + tests; the first configure # installs packages per the manifest automatically) cmake --preset dev cmake --build --preset dev ctest --preset dev ``` Presets: `dev` (development build), `ci` (Debug + coverage, the CI gate), `server-release` / `client-release` (the daily-build artifact configuration), and the platform variants `client-release-win` / `client-release-mac` / `client-release-ohos` / `server-release-mac` (a hidden `base` preset supplies the shared vcpkg settings). By default only the shared client/server dependencies (protobuf, nlohmann-json, openssl) are installed; server builds enable the manifest's `server` feature (asio, sqlite3, aws-sdk-cpp), and Qt desktop builds enable `client`. The first configure compiles qtbase and takes a while; the vcpkg binary cache (default `~/.cache/vcpkg/archives`) reuses build artifacts on later configures, which then finish in seconds. CI and daily builds use GitHub Actions caching (the `x-gha` binary cache plus the full install tree) for speed. ## Local testing conventions CI and local development split into three lanes by change surface — a one-line doc change should not trigger a full build. 1. **Doc changes** (`*.md`, `docs/**`, images): no compilation. The main CI workflow's `paths-ignore` already skips these paths. 2. **Code changes**: run only the affected subset, never the full suite. - `ctest --preset ci -R ''` 3. **Full suite** (`ctest --preset ci`): only for CMakeLists.txt, `.github/**`, Docker/Compose config changes, or pre-release. ## Deployment ### Docker (recommended) Multi-stage build (`server/Dockerfile`): the dependency layer compiles statically per the vcpkg manifest (invalidated only when `vcpkg.json` changes), the build layer produces a single binary, and the runtime layer is `ubuntu:24.04` running as non-root (uid 10001). Dependency breakdown: asio and nlohmann-json are header-only; protobuf, openssl (libcrypto), sqlite3, and aws-sdk-cpp (s3) are statically linked into the binary, so the runtime layer carries no dependency-side `.so` files beyond the base image's own system libraries. The container build and the host development tree (`x64-linux-dynamic`, shared with the Qt client) are fully independent. The vcpkg source is not cloned over the network: a snapshot is injected through a buildx named context (it must contain the commit matching the `builtin-baseline` in `vcpkg.json`; a clean clone with that commit checked out is enough, and if the snapshot carries the `downloads/` cache, the dependency layer installs fully offline). CI fetches the snapshot automatically in the workflow; local builds from source must specify it: ```bash # First image build from source: inject the vcpkg snapshot git clone https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg vcpkg-src git -C vcpkg-src checkout 10541e317a660f4165ba4ac2851ab54a8d4577b1 docker buildx build --build-context vcpkgsrc=./vcpkg-src \ -f server/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/cuihairu/memex-server:local . # One-command start: server (SQLite persistent volume) + RustFS (S3-compatible object storage) + admin web console # (compose uses the same build by default: the VCPKG_SRC environment variable points to # the snapshot, ./vcpkg-src by default; once an image exists, plain up skips the build # and needs no snapshot) docker compose up -d docker compose ps # ready once all three services are healthy # Client connections: :8088 (collaboration plane, external port aligned with the # tunnel origin tcp://192.168.5.5:8088) or :24360 (LAN default-port compat), # :24561 (file plane) # Model gateway: http://:24362 (platform phase 3; off by default — pass # --model-port N to bind it; idle unless an upstream endpoint is registered) # Admin console: http://:8089 (see below) ``` For production, write the object-storage credentials into `.env` in the same directory (`MEMEX_S3_ACCESS_KEY` / `MEMEX_S3_SECRET_KEY`) before starting; the example credentials are for local trials only. Server-side S3 flags take precedence over environment variables (`MEMEX_S3_ENDPOINT` / `MEMEX_S3_BUCKET` / `MEMEX_S3_ACCESS_KEY` / `MEMEX_S3_SECRET_KEY`); the bucket is created idempotently when the file plane starts (with retries until the endpoint is ready). The health probe is the unauthenticated file-plane `GET /files/health` (if you change the file-plane port, also set the container's `MEMEX_FILES_PORT`). Image publishing: pushing a `v*` tag or pushing to main has CI (`.github/workflows/docker.yml`) build and push `ghcr.io//memex-server` and `ghcr.io//memex-admin` (from main: immutable `sha-` plus latest; `v*` tags additionally produce semver tags), with the dependency layer on the buildx gha cache (per-image cache scopes, so the two images do not evict each other). ### Public access via Cloudflare tunnel (TCP 8088) ``` client (cloudflared access tcp) → Cloudflare edge: server.memex.cuihairu.site → user-side tunnel → origin tcp://:8088 → host 0.0.0.0:8088 → container 24360 ``` The mapping itself is configured on the user's Cloudflare side (token and tunnel config are not managed in this repo). The repo's side of the contract is one line: **publish the collaboration plane on host port 8088** (the compose default) and point the tunnel origin at the machine that actually runs `docker compose up` — if the deployment lives on a different host than the tunnel config assumes, update the origin, the port stays 8088. - Client side of a raw-TCP tunnel: the edge cannot be hit with a bare TCP client from the internet — run `cloudflared access tcp --hostname server.memex.cuihairu.site --url 127.0.0.1:8088` on the client machine, then point the Memex client at `127.0.0.1:8088`. LAN clients skip the tunnel entirely and connect to `:8088` directly. - Webhook (24361): public exposure needs its own ingress rule (an HTTP-mapped hostname or an extra HTTP ingress on the same tunnel) — deliberately **not managed in this repo**; the hook token is a bearer secret, so prefer keeping 24361 LAN-only. Status checks and troubleshooting — walk from the origin outward: ```bash # 1) Origin really serving? (all green here before blaming the tunnel) docker compose ps # server healthy nc -zv 8088 # collaboration plane accepts curl -sf http://:24561/files/health # file plane health = 200 # 2) Tunnel status (user side): Cloudflare dashboard → Zero Trust → Networks → # Tunnels, or from the cloudflared host: cloudflared tunnel list && cloudflared tunnel info # 3) Client cannot connect? In order: does server.memex.cuihairu.site resolve? # → tunnel HEALTHY (connector online)? → can the cloudflared host reach # :8088? → is the client really going through cloudflared access # (a bare TCP client never reaches the edge)? # LAN alternative: hosts-override the domain to the server IP and connect # directly — no tunnel in the path. ``` **LAN direct connect: domain resolution override.** Default is no override — on the public internet the domain resolves through normal DNS into the tunnel. Inside the LAN you can pin `server.memex.cuihairu.site` to the real server IP so traffic never leaves the segment; pick one of: - **Client setting (built-in)**: Memex menu Settings → Connection Settings…, fill "domain resolution override" as `domain=IP` (`server.memex.cuihairu.site=192.168.5.5`; several entries separated by `;`). > (the other is `pi-desktop-ark`, the **HarmonyOS Edition**, which uses ArkWeb + an in-process Node runtime

> ([harmonypc-electron](https://atomgit.com/jianguoxu/harmonypc-electron),

> HarmonyOS device, and the renderer loads the Pi Web UI served by that same-origin server.

## What this is

`Pi` is a minimal, extensible agent harness: extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes
are all replaceable, and it offers four official integration entry points (CLI / RPC / JSON /
SDK). `Pi Web` is its local browser UI (a Next.js app) where **a single Node process serves
both the SPA and `/api/*`**, and the agent is created inside that process.

This project wraps all of that in a native HarmonyOS desktop shell (the Electron-on-HarmonyOS
runtime) so it runs like a first-class desktop application on HarmonyOS PCs and tablets. It is
**not** a thin shell that "wraps a browser pointed at localhost".

> **Unofficial notice**: This project is not built by the Pi or Pi Web teams, has no
> affiliation with the upstream authors, and is not endorsed by them. Both `Pi` and `Pi Web`
> are MIT-licensed upstream open-source projects; this project is merely a third-party port of
> their desktop form factor to HarmonyOS.

## Core design

```
┌─ HarmonyOS HAP (pi-desktop-hos) ─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  electron module (entry): 3 native SOs + libc++_shared.so + Ability setup │
│  web_engine module (HAR): ArkTS bridge layer + resfile carrying app assets│
│   ┌─ Electron main process (Node 22.17.0) ───────────────────────────┐    │
│   │  main.js: env wiring → extract pi-dist → in-process Next server  │    │
│   │           → create window                                        │    │
│   │    ├─ Next server 0.0.0.0:<random port>: SPA + /api/* + SSE       │    │
│   │    ├─ agent session (pi SDK, in-process)                          │    │
│   │    └─ when ready, loadURL(http://<LAN IP>:<port>/)                │    │
│   └──────────────────────▲───────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                          │ same-origin (no CORS, no Host/Origin rewrite)  │
│   ┌──────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ Renderer: Electron BrowserWindow (Chromium)                       │   │
│   │   standard Pi Web UI (fetch /api/* + SSE /api/agent/[id]/events)  │   │
│   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Key points:

- **The server runs inside the main process**, with no Node child process — this sidesteps
  three platform problems at once: "JIT in an app-domain child process is blocked by seccomp",
  "a child's `exit`/`close` events are never observable", and "every spawn leaks a zombie".
- **Same-origin renderer**: zero CORS, zero custom protocol, zero preload bridge, zero IPC
  carrier.
- **No Host/Origin header rewriting needed**: pi-web's request trust fence admits any IP
  literal, so same-origin requests pass the Origin check naturally (this saves an entire set of
  patches compared with the sibling project `dsh-desktop-hos`).
- **Command execution and file search are taken over by pure-JS extensions shipped in the HAP**
  (requirement 102): `bash` uses a resident `/system/bin/sh` plus a random sentinel line, and
  decides completion **from stdout alone**, never waiting for process events that never arrive;
  `find` / `grep` use a pure-JS directory walk with **zero `fd`/`rg` and zero child processes**.
  This is fully transparent to the model and to pi-web presets.
- **Zero patches are required**: all 8 registered candidates are covered by existing upstream
  mechanisms or by the shell extensions (see [patches/README.md](patches/README.md)).
- **Branding is applied to the upstream artifact copy** (requirement 103): UI text, the Logo and
  every icon slot use parent-project assets, and the home page's new-version check is disabled;
  `pi` / `pi-web` / `harmonypc-electron` are **untouched**.
- **Low-cost app-store compliance is front-loaded**: no browser semantics are declared
  (`browsable` / `viewData`); all external web pages go through the ArkWeb external-link page.

├── AppScope/                    # app-level config (bundleName / version / icons / label)
├── electron/                    # entry module (populated by collect-runtime; libs/ is not committed)
├── web_engine/                  # HAR bridge layer + resfile carrying app assets (populated by collect-runtime)
├── src-main/                    # Electron main-process sources (main.js + tar-extract.js)

**Why `electron/` and `web_engine/` are script-generated**: they come from the runtime shell in
the sibling `harmonypc-electron` (ArkTS code + native SOs + Chromium resources). hvigor only
builds directories that **physically exist** in the module list of `build-profile.json5`, and a
HAR's `file:` dependency **does not carry `.so` or `resfile`** — so the runtime must be copied in
physically by `collect-runtime.mjs`. This project commits only **configuration + overlays**;
upstream copies are re-collected by the scripts, so re-running the scripts after an upstream
update cannot produce "someone edited an upstream file and nobody knew" drift. (The `resfile`
drop-in artifacts are currently **committed**, contradicting the previous README's wording; see
risk R17.)

## Capability boundaries (known device-side limitations)

> The table below summarizes [docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-v0.11.1.md](docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-v0.11.1.md);

| Capability | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Main UI (Pi Desktop Web) | ✅ | In-process server + Chromium rendering |
| Session persistence / resume | ✅ | JSONL written under the sandbox `pi-agent/sessions/` |
| File read / write / edit / list | ✅ | Pure Node.js |
| Command execution (the `bash` tool) | ✅ | Replaced under the same name by `extensions/harmony-exec.js`: a resident non-PTY `/system/bin/sh` (mksh R59) + a random sentinel line; completion is judged from stdout alone and **never waits** for `exit`/`close` |
| File lookup / content search (the `find` / `grep` tools) | ✅ | Replaced under the same names by `extensions/harmony-search.js`: a pure-JS walk with **zero `fd`/`rg` and zero child processes**; `rg`/`fd` are still absent, but no longer needed |

| `git` integration / worktree | ❌ | No `git` binary on the device, and no way to install one |
| Network plugin installation | ❌ | PL1 "local sources only" + `PI_OFFLINE=1`; no npm/git on the device |
| MCP stdio servers | ⚠️ | The blocking root cause (child-exit events never delivered) was lifted with the `bash` takeover, and the channel was verified at the transport level; **no real MCP server has been attached** (`config/mcp.json` is empty) |
| Running Node scripts in a child process | ❌ | `node -e` produces no stdout/stderr and the process becomes a zombie; the **termination cause could not be read** |
| User directories (Desktop/Documents/Download) read/write | ❌ | OS authorization gate; requires granting access in *Settings → Apps → Allow access* and **restarting the app** — in-app approval does not change this |
| Symbolic links (`symlink`) | ❌ | Refused in **both** the app domain and the shell domain (`EACCES` / `Permission denied`) |
| Auto-start at boot / background residency | ❌ / ⚠️ | Read-only interfaces and no public setter; minimizing under 2in1 does not produce a real background state |
| File fencing for commands | ⚠️ | The `bash` child runs as the application identity (uid `20020215`) and therefore **bypasses pi's file-approval flow**; the only mitigation is a skill-level constraint |
